title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Tidying Up!
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends learn how to tidy up their play area! Bella has a fun idea to make cleaning up exciting. Together, they discover that tidying up can be a teamwork adventure, making space for more fun!
lesson: Kids learn the importance of tidying up and working together.
beats: 1. Baby Leo and friends are playing with toys, making a big mess. They laugh and enjoy their playtime together, but soon the area looks very messy.
2. Bella hops up and says, 'Let’s make cleaning up fun!' Everyone looks curious. Baby Leo asks, 'How can we do that?'
3. Marjona suggests a game where they race to see who can pick up the most toys. Bobo giggles and says, 'I love games!'
4. The friends start picking up toys while laughing and cheering each other on. They feel happy and excited while working together.
5. As they clean, Twinkle glows bright to make it feel magical. The friends sing a cleaning song that Marjona created.
6. Once the area is tidy, they step back to admire their work. Baby Leo says, 'Wow, it looks great!' Everyone smiles and claps.
7. Bella reminds her friends that tidying up is quicker with teamwork. They all agree and high-five each other.
8. They sit down on the clean floor, ready to play again, feeling proud of their teamwork. Twinkle sparkles in joy!
9. Bobo suggests a snack break to celebrate their tidy space. They all cheer and agree it’s a great idea.
10. The friends enjoy their snacks together, laughing and planning their next adventure, knowing they can always tidy up together!
